decisions.name: 海通证券
reasoning: Transfer-financing formally launched and, within 10 trading days, system margin-financing balance had risen by nearly RMB3bn while Securities Finance had lent about RMB7.1bn, close to its RMB7.5bn initial capital ceiling.
This satisfies V2's realized-system-flow condition rather than relying on policy authorization alone.
Haitong had direct, already-material economics: 2012H1 margin-financing interest income was about RMB218m, among the industry's highest, with roughly 10% market share around Q1.
Price absorption at Sep-14 was moderate: 20d excess about +7.6pp, 60d excess only +0.8pp; the event was not an extreme momentum chase.
Incremental economics were not pure: large brokers had ample own capital and transfer-financing cost around 6%, reducing the incremental spread. This keeps the case at Research.

decisions.name: 中信证券
reasoning: The QFII ceiling increased from USD30bn to USD80bn, but the additional quota was capacity rather than immediate deployed flow.
At the initial event checkpoint there was no realized-system-flow evidence satisfying V2.
Citic had already outperformed CSI300 by about +16.8pp over 60d, adding expectation burden.
Later quota approvals cannot be used to retroactively convert the April authorization into realized flow.
Rate cuts changed system liquidity broadly but no unique company quantity/sensitivity with one-directional net incidence was frozen.

shadowControls.reason: Authorized quota without realized system flow.
